extName.description: The extension's name in Chrome and the Web Store. Keep "TypeTarget" as is.

extDescription.message: Transcribe browser tab audio directly into any text field, with your choice of AI model for free.
extDescription.description: The extension's summary in Chrome and the Web Store. At most 132 characters.

textDirection.description: The direction this language is written in: ltr (left to right) or rtl (right to left). Lays out the popup and editor tab.

locale.description: This file's locale as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. pt-BR. Do not translate. Names the languages in the Spoken language menu.

statusDownloading.description: A model download whose total size is unknown.

engineUnloaded.description: The transcription model's state, after "Model:" in Diagnostics.

sessionReconnecting.description: $REASON$ is an error message from the provider, in English.

fallingBehind.message: This device is transcribing slower than real time with this local model.

spokenLanguageHeading.description: The language people speak in the captured audio, which the transcription model expects.

spokenLanguageAuto.description: Spoken language option: the model detects the language by itself. Keep it short.

apiKeyStorageNote.message: Your API key is stored on this device only, used solely to authenticate requests to the provider.

apiKeyNetworkNote.message: Audio is sent to $PROVIDER$ for processing.

apiKeyRequired.description: Shown beside the Model heading while the selected hosted model has no saved key.

listeningToHeading.description: Heading above the name of the tab being transcribed.

chunkLength.description: Setting under the listening button: the longest stretch of continuous speech sent to the model at once. Longer helps the model tell which language is spoken; shorter gets text sooner.

chunkLengthValue.description: The chunk length setting's current value, beside its name. Always 3 to 25; where the word for seconds changes with the number, use the abbreviation.

typingToHeading.description: Heading above the name of the text box the transcript goes into.

showOutline.description: Setting: draw an outline, timer and buttons on the text box being typed into.

outputErrorNoTab.description: Errors beside the Typing to heading, so kept short.

outputErrorPageBlocked.description: Chrome doesn't let extensions into this page, such as a chrome:// page or the Web Store.

outputErrorNoTextBox.message: Click into the text box, then right-click it again.
outputErrorNoTextBox.description: After Type to this field, when no text box had the focus.

outputErrorUnavailable.message: The text box is no longer available.
outputErrorUnavailable.description: The text box being typed into, or its tab, has gone.

outputErrorMoveBackOutline.message: Turn on "$SETTING$" to move the text back.
outputErrorMoveBackOutline.description: The editor tab's Move back to page needs the Show outline setting.

outputErrorMoveBackGone.message: The page the text came from is closed or has changed.

helpLink.description: Link at the popup's foot to the FAQ on the website.

diagnosticsNoAudio.message: No audio detected. Check tab volume.

diagnosticsInferenceFailed.description: Appended to "Inference: …"; keep the leading separator.

diagnosticsInferenceLast.description: Appended to "Inference: …"; keep the leading separator.

modelGroupLocal.description: Model menu heading for models that run on this computer.

badgeControls.description: Accessible name of the buttons on the text box being typed into.
